headline.caveat: total debt tranche arranged/led by Apollo and Diameter Capital Partners with other lenders; Apollo's own share undisclosed

nature_md: Apollo, together with Diameter Capital Partners and other private-credit lenders, arranged ~$12.5B of debt for the ~$20B xAI GPU SPV. The debt is collateralized by the NVIDIA GPUs the SPV purchases and serviced by xAI's lease payments over ~5 years — GPU-backed lending where recovery depends on chips retaining resale value, one of the most-watched credit experiments of the cycle. This edge records the debt tranche with Apollo as the identifiable lead; the full lender list is not public.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Private-credit assets across Apollo-managed funds and insurance balance sheets (Athene); yield reflects GPU-residual and single-lessee (xAI) risk.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Senior secured debt of the SPV, above the ~$7.5B equity; not a liability of xAI itself — the point of the structure is that xAI's balance sheet carries a lease, not $12.5B of debt.
